schema.header_digest_encoding: Parsed header joined by TAB plus one final LF, UTF-8; full feature order is guarded.

input_configuration.portable_layout: Bundled paths resolve from the invoked package root (or --inputs package-root override), independently of config location. External paths resolve from the selected config directory. No automatic download or path substitution.
input_configuration.generated_inputs: Use the documented retained producer in a new output directory, then explicitly bind its product in a separate config. Frozen hash checks protect the recorded state; a new scientific run is not presumed identical.
input_configuration.profiles: Only the current recovered-kegg profile is exposed. Its requests and responses are paired and not replaced by live service calls.
input_configuration.validation_scope: Preflight checks input presence, hashes, declared schemas and installed-distribution metadata; it does not execute statistical analyses.
input_configuration.merged_sources: Recorded result paths are logical source identifiers in the HDF5 master file embedded source_index. Token-validated source slices preserve original schema, row order and source-local read_csv typing. Explicit external file/directory bindings remain supported.
